job: stars you can see without a telescope, as data and as sky charts

pitch.en: The stars you can see without a telescope, with names, colours and distances; the 88 constellations with their lines and boundaries; the Messier objects; and seven map projections to draw them on.
pitch.ja: 肉眼で見える星の名前・色・距離、88星座の線と境界、メシエ天体、そしてそれらを描くための7種類の図法を使えます。

name.en: Hoshi is the Japanese word 星 for a star.
name.ja: 「星」(ほし) は、夜空に光って見えるものです。

..en: Stars: names, positions, distance and colour
..ja: 星の名前・位置・距離・色

./constellations.en: The 88 constellations, in English and Japanese

./sheets.en: Printable sheets: connect-the-dots constellations, the constellations for a latitude, a star wheel to cut out and a sky map for each month
./sheets.ja: 印刷するシート: 星座の点つなぎ、緯度に合わせた星座、切り抜きの星の回転盤、月ごとの星空の地図

./culture.en: Sky cultures: the figure and culture types, and your own culture
./culture.ja: 星座の文化 (図形と文化の型、自分で作る文化)

./cultures/western.en: The Western sky: the 88 constellations in Latin, English, Japanese and Chinese, and asterisms such as the Big Dipper and the Summer Triangle
./cultures/western.ja: 西洋の空 (88星座をラテン語・英語・日本語・中国語で、北斗七星や夏の大三角などの星の並び)

./cultures/japanese.en: The traditional Japanese sky: 昴 Subaru, 北斗七星, 鼓星 and other old names and figures, with readings
./cultures/japanese.ja: 日本の伝統の空 (昴・北斗七星・鼓星などの昔の呼び名と図形、読みつき)

./cultures/chinese.en: The traditional Chinese sky: the Three Enclosures and Twenty-Eight Mansions, about 240 asterisms with Traditional and Simplified names and pinyin
./cultures/chinese.ja: 中国の伝統の空 (三垣二十八宿、約240の星官。繁体字・簡体字・ピンインつき)

./profile.en: A star's profile: temperature, size, luminosity and disc size with their uncertainty, limb darkening, and the measured shapes of Altair, Regulus and Vega
./profile.ja: 星のプロファイル (温度・大きさ・光度・円盤の大きさを不確かさつきで、周縁減光、アルタイル・レグルス・ベガの測定された形)

./portrait.en: A star drawn from its numbers as SVG, and next to the Sun
./portrait.ja: 数値から描いた星のSVGの絵と、太陽との大きさくらべ

./thumbnails.en: A picture of each of the 88 constellations, in light and dark
./thumbnails.ja: 88星座それぞれの絵 (明るい版と暗い版)

./constellation-facts.en: Facts for a gallery or a list: meaning, hemisphere, best month, origin, difficulty, asterisms, meteor showers
./constellation-facts.ja: ギャラリーや一覧のための豆知識 (意味・半球・見ごろの月・由来・見つけやすさ・アステリズム・流星群)

./boundaries.en: Constellation boundaries and which constellation a point is in
./boundaries.ja: 星座の境界と、ある点がどの星座にあるか

./deep-sky/ngc-ic.en: NGC and IC objects as well

./black-holes.en: Black holes: 301 with a place, a mass and distance with ranges, how each was found and the paper behind each fact
./black-holes.ja: ブラックホール (位置・質量と距離(範囲つき)・見つけた方法・出典の論文つきの301個)

./deep-sky/shape.en: How big a Messier object is on the sky and which way it lies, and its outline
./deep-sky/shape.ja: メシエ天体の空での大きさと向き、その輪郭

./deep-sky/ngc-ic-shape.en: The same for the NGC and IC objects
./deep-sky/ngc-ic-shape.ja: NGC・IC天体の大きさと向き

./deep-sky/pictures.en: Pictures of deep-sky objects and where each lies on the sky
./deep-sky/pictures.ja: ディープスカイ天体の写真と、それぞれの空での位置

./deep-sky/members.en: The bright catalogue stars inside a cluster's outline
./deep-sky/members.ja: 星団の輪郭の中にあるカタログの明るい星

./all-sky.en: The whole sky on one wide 2:1 map: galactic or equatorial, Mollweide, Hammer or plate carrée, with lines cut cleanly at the seam
./all-sky.ja: 全天を1枚の横長 (2対1) の地図に (銀河座標か赤道座標、モルワイデ・ハンマー・正距円筒図法。継ぎ目で線をきれいに切る)

./milky-way.en: The Milky Way: a brightness map and soft bands to draw
./milky-way.ja: 天の川 (明るさの地図と、描くための帯)

./nearest.en: What is near a star, an object or a point, in the sky and in space; neighbouring constellations
./nearest.ja: 星・天体・位置の近くにあるもの (空と宇宙で)、隣り合う星座

./nearby.en: Nearby stars: Proxima Centauri, Barnard's Star and about 5,600 more, with distance and error
./nearby.ja: 近くの星 (プロキシマ・ケンタウリ、バーナード星など約5,600個、距離と誤差つき)

./sky.en: Your sky: altitude and azimuth for a place and a moment
./sky.ja: 自分の空 (場所と時刻から高度と方位)

./faint.en: The faint stars: about 3 million of UCAC4's, to magnitude 12, in sky tiles loaded for the part of the sky you show
./faint.ja: 暗い星 (UCAC4の約300万個、12等まで。見ている空の部分のタイルだけを読み込みます)

./door.en: The data door: hand the package your own stars or objects as a source with its own licence and credit, and see whose data is on the screen
./door.ja: データの入口（自分で用意した星やディープスカイ天体を、ライセンスと出典つきのソースとして渡し、いま画面にあるのは誰のデータかを示します）

./sky-labels.en: Names on the brightest stars and the constellation figures as faint lines, for a sky you draw yourself: a count or a magnitude, the figure under the pointer at full strength, a body that covers part of the sky, and a look set by settings alone
./sky-labels.ja: いちばん明るい星の名前と、うすい星座の線 (自分で描く空のために。個数か等級で選べます。ポインターが乗っている星座は濃く表示でき、空をおおうものにも対応し、見た目は設定だけで変えられます)

./distance.en: The sky out to a distance, in layers: the stars and galaxies nearer than 10, 50, 100, 500 or 1,000 light-years, each distance band its own colour, the ones with an uncertain distance kept apart, and none placed at a guess
./distance.ja: 距離で見る空 (10・50・100・500・1,000光年より近い星や銀河を層に分けて、距離の帯ごとに色分けします。距離がはっきりしないものは別にし、推測で置くことはしません)

./sky-from.en: The sky seen from another star: positions, distances and brightness from there, with the Sun among the stars
./sky-from.ja: ほかの星から見た空 (そこから見た位置・距離・明るさ。太陽も星のひとつ)

./constellation-3d.en: A constellation in 3D: its stars placed in space from their parallaxes, with the range each error allows and the Earth's lines of sight
./constellation-3d.ja: 立体の星座 (視差から星を空間に置き、誤差の範囲と地球からの視線を示す)

./sky-from/nearby.en: The sky seen from another star, with the nearby stars moved too
./sky-from/nearby.ja: ほかの星から見た空 (近くの星も動かす)

./near-stars.en: The 73 star systems within 20 light-years, with names in English and Japanese, place, distance, companions and the source of each value
./near-stars.ja: 20光年以内の73の星系 (英語と日本語の名前、位置、距離、伴星、値ごとの出典つき)

./accuracy.en: How well each value of a star is known: the source and error of its position, magnitude, colour, parallax and proper motion, and a grade A, B or C
./accuracy.ja: 星ごとの値の確かさ (位置・明るさ・色・視差・固有運動の出典と誤差、A・B・Cの等級)

./exoplanet-hosts.en: The host stars of confirmed exoplanets worth a visit: place, distance, and each planet's name and orbital period
./exoplanet-hosts.ja: 確認された系外惑星をもつ、訪ねてみたい星 (位置・距離、惑星ごとの名前と公転周期)

./tonight.en: What you can see tonight: the stars above the horizon of a place and a moment that the Sun's light, the sky's darkness and the air still let through, with the twilight, each star's altitude and azimuth and how easy it is to see
./tonight.ja: 今夜見える星 (場所と時刻から、地平線の上にあり、太陽の光・空の明るさ・大気の減光のあとでも見える星を、薄明の種類、高度と方位、見やすさつきで)
